description: Erection of a front boundary wall with railings and pedestrian and vehicular gates.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (90-01 (Rev F)  Received:  31 March 2021;  800  Received:  16 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The proposed front boundary treatment shall be constructed with imperial red brick and London yellow solider brick walls, regency sandstone pier caps and black wrought iron railings and gates only.

Condition : 4 - No solid wall, fences or gates shall be erected as part of the house's front boundary treatment which exceeds a height of 0.6 metres.  

The existing vehicle crossover shall not be used and shall be removed in conjunction with the Local Highways Authority if the front boundary treatment hereby approved is removed in future and not replaced with a compliant replacement front boundary treatment designed in accordance with the Council's Residential Crossovers and Off-Street Parking Policy (or subsequent replacement policies).
